scope: Research-informed A–D density revisions, Walker B and Spider D, autonomous wildlife, emissive turret accents, staggered cooperative targeting; saved assets and authored weather off. CPU resource accounting and actual transformed vertex clip checks, not GPU timing.
notes: Geometry bytes are uploaded vertex/index/matrix payloads. Shared render targets, uniforms, lazy effect pools and source JSON are excluded. Three scene buffers per nonempty opaque draw group, plus three for water.
Camera probes use the unmodified default framed overview at stated CSS aspect ratios. Geometry is checked at the initial actor pose; the separate gait tests cover animated clearance and bends.
Shadow depth remains 2048 squared; the projection spans the complete square level. No quality, light, camera or GPU code change was necessary for these placements.
Optional weather remains off and allocates no fields or GPU seed buffers. Enabled counts are capacity projections under existing constants, not a request to change accepted weather tuning.
All static visibility cuboids come from occupied source cells and terrain, preserving holes; water, player defences and moving enemies are excluded.
Static scenery uses quarter-turn placement and one unposed rigid part. Arbitrarily posed scenery would need a different visibility representation.

Exact path/deployment box clearance below checks every occupied scenery cell, including unit-offset detail props, against reserved boxes. It does not claim an arbitrary-angle tower sweep is safe for every future player placement.

Wildlife navigation counts updated after approved path crossing/flee behaviour; actual combat/event audit is wildlife-combat-review.json. Geometry, camera, LOS and combat evidence above is unchanged by this cosmetic update.
candidateValidationLimits: Finite one-unit route samples of both actual muzzle rays, supplemented by real combat checks. C uses a reference torso height because no enemy is assigned.
Each plot is considered individually; this does not approve overlapping neighbouring turrets.
The cylinder contains every rotating head vertex and the complete recoil interval. Zero static-cuboid intersections is conservative all-yaw clearance.
